# proxmox_apl_templates (Data Source)

Lists appliance templates from `/nodes/{node}/aplinfo`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_apl_templates" "templates" {
  node = "pve"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `node` (String)
